sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正为你们制作终极版《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会剖析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: I'm sitting in a different seat today.
Is it going to bring a new energy to the pod?
sentences.zh: 这会给播客带来新的活力吗？

sentences.en: Is it going to give me a crick in my neck?
Well, guys, things are going to be crazy.
sentences.zh: 好吧，伙计们，接下来会很疯狂。

sentences.en: Today, we're sitting in new spots.
Today, we're breaking down new leads, which is Season 6, Episode 20.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要剖析的是《新线索》，也就是第六季第20集。

sentences.en: Lady, there's only six more episodes before we head into Season 7.
sentences.zh: 女士，在进入第七季之前，只剩下六集了。

sentences.en: But I want to point out, we did 26 episodes in Season 6.
sentences.zh: 但我得指出，我们在第六季拍了26集。

sentences.en: That is a huge number of episodes for a television season.
sentences.zh: 对于一个电视季来说，这可是个庞大的数字。

sentences.en: We all got sick at the end.
We all caught a cold bug.
sentences.zh: 我们都染上了感冒病毒。

sentences.en: I have a little bit of trivia for you before we even start.
sentences.zh: 在开始之前，我有个小花絮要告诉你们。

sentences.en: I looked in my digital clutter.
sentences.zh: 我翻了翻我的数字杂物。

sentences.en: The original title for this episode was Scavenger Hunt.
sentences.zh: 这一集的原始标题是《寻宝游戏》。

sentences.en: The table read, it was called Scavenger Hunt.
sentences.zh: 剧本围读的时候，它叫《寻宝游戏》。

sentences.en: I'm telling you, sitting in new spots, trivia right at the top, what's next?
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，换了新座位，一上来就有花絮，接下来还有什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'll tell you, this episode was written by Brent Forrester and directed by Brent Forrester.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我告诉你，这一集是由布伦特·福雷斯特编剧并执导的。

sentences.en: I'm going to hit you with a summary now for new leads, formerly known as Scavenger Hunt.
sentences.zh: 现在我要给你们讲讲《新线索》的剧情摘要，也就是以前叫《寻宝游戏》的那集。

sentences.en: Saber's new policies favoring the sales team have caused them to become obnoxious toward their co-workers.
sentences.zh: 赛博公司偏袒销售团队的新政策让他们对同事变得傲慢无礼。

sentences.en: Michael attempts to check their egos and teach humility by refusing to hand out the new sales leads.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔试图通过拒绝分发新的销售线索来打压他们的自负并教导他们谦逊。

sentences.en: Instead, Michael gives them to the non-sales staff who hide them around the office.
sentences.zh: 相反，迈克尔把线索交给了非销售人员，让他们把线索藏在办公室各处。

sentences.en: A bunch of them end up in a dump where Michael and Dwight and Aaron and Andy further their respective relationships.
sentences.zh: 其中一大堆线索最终落到了垃圾场，迈克尔、德怀特、亚伦和安迪在那里进一步发展了他们各自的关系。

sentences.en: He basically hid $50,000 around the office.
sentences.zh: 他基本上把5万美元藏在了办公室里。

sentences.en: Fast fact number one is a fan question from Alexandra in Huntsville, Alabama, who said,
sentences.zh: 第一个快讯来自阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的亚历山德拉，她问：

sentences.en: Alexandra, I think this is a really good thing to start with because if we aren't clear on what a lead is, this episode is going to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉，我觉得这个问题作为开场非常好，因为如果我们不搞清楚什么是销售线索，这期节目就没法录了。

sentences.en: And we say the word leads 33 times in this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们在这一期节目里一共说了33次“销售线索”。

sentences.en: We really need to know what that is.
sentences.zh: 我们确实得搞清楚那是什么。

sentences.en: I will tell you, according to Investopedia, a sales lead is a person or business who may eventually become a client.
sentences.zh: 我来告诉你，根据Investopedia的定义，销售线索是指可能最终成为客户的个人或企业。

sentences.en: Businesses gain access to sales leads through advertising, trade shows, direct mailings, third parties, and other marketing efforts.
sentences.zh: 企业通过广告、展会、直邮、第三方以及其他营销手段获取销售线索。

sentences.en: Sales people then use those leads to send sales pitch emails or direct marketing materials and to make cold calls.
sentences.zh: 销售人员随后利用这些线索发送推销邮件、直邮营销材料或进行电话推销。

sentences.en: Now, several factors determine the quality of a sales lead, such as whether or not the individual or business had an incentive to offer their contact information.
sentences.zh: 现在，有几个因素决定了销售线索的质量，比如个人或企业提供联系方式时是否有某种激励。

sentences.en: You know, like when they say, get a free steak dinner, if you listen to this sales pitch about a timeshare and fill out an information card,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像他们说的那样，如果你去听关于分时度假的推销演讲并填写一张信息卡，就能免费吃顿牛排大餐，

sentences.en: those information cards would be considered leads that then a person will follow up on and try to sell you that timeshare.
sentences.zh: 那些信息卡就会被视为销售线索，之后会有人跟进并试图向你推销那个分时度假产品。

sentences.en: But if you got something in return, you might have just been there for the free steak dinner.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是为了得到某种回报，那你可能只是为了那顿免费牛排才去的。

sentences.en: So those are kind of bum leads.
sentences.zh: 所以那些算是质量不高的线索。

sentences.en: You know, when you take an online survey?
sentences.zh: 你知道当你做在线调查的时候吗？

sentences.en: I always do the online survey.
Oh, well, this explains my spam mail.
sentences.zh: 哦，那这就解释了我的垃圾邮件为什么那么多。

sentences.en: I was going to say, nowadays, they create sales lead by tracking your purchases online.
sentences.zh: 我正想说，现在他们通过追踪你的在线购买记录来制造销售线索。

sentences.en: And then you get targeted ads to watch.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会看到针对性的广告。

sentences.en: I'm a real sucker for those.
sentences.zh: 我特别容易被那些广告吸引。

sentences.en: Lady, let me tell you, I watched an episode of John Oliver about third-party tracking that blew my mind.
sentences.zh: 女士，我跟你说，我看了约翰·奥利弗关于第三方追踪的一期节目，简直让我大开眼界。

sentences.en: So when you go on a website, when you look at something, when you fill out your information, and sometimes you get a little disclaimer, like,
sentences.zh: 所以当你访问网站、浏览商品、填写信息时，有时会弹出一个免责声明，比如，

sentences.en: are you okay to accept this or fill out this?
sentences.zh: 你是否同意接受或填写这些内容？

sentences.en: And you click it, if you don't read all of it, and it's a ton of tiny little words, and they say a lot in there somewhere, it's like that they can then give that information.
sentences.zh: 如果你点击了，但没有读完所有内容，那里面全是密密麻麻的小字，其中某处写着他们可以将这些信息提供给别人。

sentences.en: The site that you're actually interested in, like Hummingbird Feeders, can then give your information to maybe someone who makes mattresses,
sentences.zh: 你原本感兴趣的网站，比如卖蜂鸟喂食器的地方，可能会把你的信息给卖床垫的，

sentences.en: who then can give your information to someone who makes tires, and then who knows where your information is going.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又会把你的信息给卖轮胎的，谁知道你的信息最后会流向哪里。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, a third party that you don't even know has your information.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，一个你根本不认识的第三方就掌握了你的信息。

sentences.en: So there's a setting on your phone and on your computer where you can turn off that tracking.
sentences.zh: 所以你的手机和电脑上有一个设置，可以关闭那种追踪功能。

sentences.en: So I went in and I did that.
sentences.zh: 所以我进去把它关掉了。

sentences.en: Oh, will you teach me how to do that when we get done doing this podcast?
sentences.zh: 哦，等我们录完这期播客，你能教我怎么弄吗？

sentences.en: Well, I've bought a ton of stuff from ads.
sentences.zh: 我确实从广告里买过很多东西。

sentences.en: Like, an ad will pop up, and you're like, I got a dress on Instagram today.
sentences.zh: 就是那种广告会突然弹出来，然后你就买了，我今天就在Instagram上买了一条裙子。
我买了那个耳垢清理器。

sentences.en: But I did buy that countertop composter.
sentences.zh: 但我确实买了那个台面堆肥桶。

sentences.en: I got in on that early.
I watched that ad before they were even available, and I was one of the people who bought it when it was, like,
sentences.zh: 在它还没上市前我就看了广告，当它上市时，我就是那批购买者之一，当时，就像是，

sentences.en: at a discount because you were helping them as part of their startup.
sentences.zh: 因为你是作为初创阶段的支持者，所以还有折扣。

sentences.en: I waited seven months for that thing.
Well, you were a lead, and it worked.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你是个潜在客户，而且它确实好用。

sentences.en: I have a thing that keeps popping up in my Instagram, you guys, and I took a screen grab.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我Instagram上一直弹出一个东西，我截了图。

sentences.en: Because I told Josh I want it for my birthday.
sentences.zh: 因为我告诉乔什我想把它当生日礼物。

sentences.en: It's a little tiny camera that goes in your bird feeder.
sentences.zh: 那是一个装在喂鸟器里的小型摄像头。

sentences.en: And then you can, like, learn all about your birds, and you can watch your birds.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以，比如，了解所有关于你家鸟儿的事，还可以观察它们。

sentences.en: I saw that in an ad, and I sent it to you.
sentences.zh: 我在广告里看到了，然后发给了你。

sentences.en: Well, anyway, these leads from Sabre are businesses that have been predetermined to want new printers, which should make it way easier than just making cold calls.
sentences.zh: 总之，Sabre提供的这些潜在客户名单，都是预先确定想要新打印机的企业，这应该比单纯打冷电话要容易得多。

sentences.en: You know, I worked as a telemarketer, Angela, for the St. Louis Post-Dispatch.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你知道吗，我以前在《圣路易斯邮报》做过电话推销员。

sentences.en: And you had to make cold calls?
I had to make cold calls, but I had leads.
sentences.zh: 我得打冷电话，但我有潜在客户名单。

sentences.en: They were people who had expressed an interest in having a subscription to the paper, or they were people who got the Sunday paper,
sentences.zh: 他们要么是表示过对订阅报纸感兴趣的人，要么是订了周日版报纸的人，

sentences.en: and I was calling them to see if they wanted to get it every day.
sentences.zh: 我打电话是想问他们愿不愿意每天都订。

sentences.en: You would have called me because I get the Sunday paper, and someone reached out to me and were like, would you like to also get the Tuesday to support the paper?
sentences.zh: 那你肯定会打给我，因为我订了周日版，有人联系我说，你愿不愿意为了支持报社也订一份周二的？

sentences.en: So now I get it on Tuesday and Sunday.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我周二和周日都会收到报纸。

sentences.en: You helped that person bump up their sales record, too, so that person's happy.
sentences.zh: 你也帮那个人提高了销售记录，所以那个人也很高兴。
我们知道什么是潜在客户了。

sentences.en: I think we all got it.
River Valley, Oregon, and Rolla Bee from Toronto, Canada, they would all like to know what's up with the dump.
sentences.zh: 俄勒冈州河谷市的，还有加拿大多伦多的罗拉·比，他们都想知道垃圾场是怎么回事。

sentences.en: They would like a location breakdown on the dump because they said the dumpster really looks like it was green screened.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一份关于垃圾场的地点分析，因为他们说那个垃圾箱看起来真的很像绿幕合成的。

sentences.en: How much of it is real?
And how did they get all the garbage that Dwight and Michael threw at each other?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么弄到德怀特和迈克尔互相扔的那些垃圾的？

sentences.en: We built our version of the Scranton dump on our warehouse stage in front of a massive green screen.
sentences.zh: 我们在摄影棚的仓库里，对着一块巨大的绿幕搭建了我们版本的斯克兰顿垃圾场。

sentences.en: Randy told me it's called a cyclorama.
sentences.zh: 兰迪告诉我那叫全景幕。

sentences.en: It actually curved around the entire periphery of the interior of our stage, too.
sentences.zh: 它实际上还绕着我们摄影棚内部的整个周边围了一圈。

sentences.en: Prior to shooting, we actually did an enormous amount of research about what the actual landfill in Scranton, Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: 在拍摄之前，我们确实做了大量的调研，研究宾夕法尼亚州斯克兰顿真正的垃圾填埋场

sentences.en: Remember Mary POTUS from the Scranton Chamber of Commerce?
sentences.zh: 还记得斯克兰顿商会的玛丽·波特斯吗？

sentences.en: She sent pictures of the Scranton dump.
sentences.zh: 她寄来了斯克兰顿垃圾场的照片。

sentences.en: She started by taking a picture of a patch on a firefighter's uniform, and now she's taking pictures of a dump.
sentences.zh: 她一开始只是拍了一张消防员制服上的补丁照片，现在她竟然在拍垃圾场。

sentences.en: What she was signing up for.
So, Michael Gallenberg was in charge of designing the dump, but the making of all the fake trash that Dwight and Michael throw at one another,
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克尔·加伦伯格负责设计垃圾场，但制作德怀特和迈克尔互相投掷的所有假垃圾，

sentences.en: that fell under the jurisdiction of Steve Rothstein, our set decorator.
sentences.zh: 那属于我们的布景装饰师史蒂夫·罗斯坦的管辖范围。

sentences.en: Randy told us that he met with a local recycling firm and purchased literally hundreds of bales of sanitized recycled waste.
sentences.zh: 兰迪告诉我们，他联系了一家当地的回收公司，买了几百捆经过消毒的回收废料。

sentences.en: It was mostly plastic, corrugated cardboard, and paper, but he added a little bit of household trash.
sentences.zh: 主要是塑料、瓦楞纸板和纸张，但他还加了一些生活垃圾。

sentences.en: He also threw in items that they could throw at each other, like the big cable spool, the big sink, a tennis racket.
sentences.zh: 他还放了一些他们可以互相投掷的物品，比如大电缆卷轴、大水槽、网球拍。

sentences.en: He found the big bathtub, the purple beanbag chair, all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 他找到了那个大浴缸、紫色的豆袋椅，还有所有那些东西。

sentences.en: They took our visual effects company, Stargate Studios International, to a local landfill in Eagle Rock, California,
sentences.zh: 他们带着我们的视觉特效公司——星门国际工作室，去了加州鹰岩的一个当地垃圾填埋场，

sentences.en: and they shot a bunch of video, and that's what's playing on the green screen.
sentences.zh: 拍了一堆视频，那就是绿幕上播放的内容。

sentences.en: They got the bulldozers and, you know, that flock of birds that flies through.
sentences.zh: 他们拍到了推土机，还有，你知道的，那群飞过的鸟。

sentences.en: I thought that was a nice touch.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是个不错的点缀。
他们拍了所有那些视频。

sentences.en: That went on the green screen.
sentences.zh: 那些视频被放到了绿幕上。

sentences.en: The total budget from Stargate to create that landfill behind our piles of trash was $52,000.
sentences.zh: 星门工作室制作我们垃圾堆后面那个垃圾填埋场的总预算是52000美元。

sentences.en: And that is how you get a fakie dump.
sentences.zh: 这就是你们如何得到一个假垃圾场的方法。

sentences.en: Well, finally, fast fact number three.
sentences.zh: 好了，最后是第三个冷知识。

sentences.en: I mentioned earlier that this episode was both written and directed by Brent Forrester.
sentences.zh: 我之前提到过，这一集是由布伦特·福雷斯特编剧并执导的。
你知道我们很喜欢布伦特。

sentences.en: Well, I reached out to him to see if he wanted to send in any audio clips for this,
sentences.zh: 我联系了他，看他是否愿意为这一集发来一些音频片段，

sentences.en: because he always is so generous with the audio.
sentences.zh: 因为他总是非常慷慨地提供音频。

sentences.en: I have been dreading new leads.
sentences.zh: 我一直很害怕《新线索》这一集。

sentences.en: He said, the acting is great.
Of course, you guys never waver.
sentences.zh: 当然，你们的表现从不动摇。

sentences.en: But the script got so mangled.
sentences.zh: 但剧本被改得面目全非。

sentences.en: He said he was also shooting a pilot for Ron Howard while we were doing this episode.
sentences.zh: 他说我们在拍这一集的时候，他同时还在为朗·霍华德拍一部试播集。

sentences.en: He said he just didn't feel like it turned out how we wanted.
sentences.zh: 他说他只是觉得成品没能达到我们预期的效果。

sentences.en: And then he said, oh, my God, those special effects.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，天哪，那些特效。

sentences.en: But he did still send in some audio clips.
sentences.zh: 但他还是发来了一些音频片段。

sentences.en: Here's what he had to say about this episode.
sentences.zh: 这是他关于这一集的评价。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Brent Forrester, the writer and director of New Leads.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是布伦特·福雷斯特，《新线索》的编剧兼导演。

sentences.en: There are two big problems with this episode, the writing and the directing.
sentences.zh: 这一集有两个大问题，编剧和导演。

sentences.en: The story has a fundamental flaw in it, and there's a fundamental lesson in it for all you
sentences.zh: 故事本身存在根本性的缺陷，这对你们所有编剧来说，
有一个根本性的教训，好吗？

sentences.en: The secret of storytelling in the half-hour medium is to center the story around two characters in
sentences.zh: 半小时剧集叙事的秘诀在于，将故事聚焦于两个角色之间的

sentences.en: Let that conflict build to a crisis and then resolve.
sentences.zh: 让冲突升级到危机，然后解决它。

sentences.en: That's the right story for half-hour TV.
sentences.zh: 那才是半小时电视剧该有的故事结构。

sentences.en: Who are the two characters in conflict?
It doesn't center in on Michael versus Dwight until the third act, and by then, it's too late.
sentences.zh: 直到第三幕才聚焦到迈克尔对阵德怀特，而那时已经太晚了。

sentences.en: It's so obvious to me now, but I totally miss it at the time because I was so focused on doing a
sentences.zh: 我现在看得很清楚，但当时我完全没发现，因为我当时太专注于

sentences.en: terrible job of directing this episode.
sentences.zh: 把这一集的导演工作搞砸了。

sentences.en: You're being way too critical of yourself.
Can you tell that he teaches screenwriting comedy?
sentences.zh: 看得出来他是教喜剧编剧的吧？

sentences.en: Because he always breaks it down from that intellectual level, which I love.
sentences.zh: 因为他总是从那种理论层面进行拆解，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: I always love hearing that perspective.
sentences.zh: 我一直很喜欢听这种视角。

sentences.en: Brent sent in one more audio clip.
sentences.zh: 布伦特还发来了另一个音频片段。

sentences.en: We'll play it later because he does have a favorite scene from this episode.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后再放，因为他确实有这一集中最喜欢的一场戏。

sentences.en: Well, listen, before we go to break, I have a fun little detail about this episode.
sentences.zh: 听着，在进入休息之前，我有一个关于这一集的小趣闻。

sentences.en: If you do a rewatch of this episode, look for the people wearing the little Bluetooth headphones
sentences.zh: 如果你重温这一集，留意一下那些戴着蓝牙耳机，

sentences.en: and, like, typing on their phones during meetings.
sentences.zh: 或者在开会时玩手机的人。

sentences.en: There was a lot of old tech.
